description: This file contains unit tests for the Campaigns module in SuiteCRM, testing various methods and behaviors of the Campaign class, including subscription management, data retrieval, relationship handling, and query generation.

classes.name: CampaignTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies various functionalities of the Campaign module, including CRUD operations, relationship management, query creation, and other business logic in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up global variables and configuration.
